description: Twitch channel VODs — lean rows, video-id cursor, filter/sort, top-level broadcaster{} (flat 2). Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor = last video id from the previous nextCursor. Leave empty for the first page. Pages the first 100 matching videos only (not a raw offset).

filterBy.description: ARCHIVE | HIGHLIGHT | UPLOAD. Omit for all types — there is no default filter (unset filterBy is omitted, not null).

limit.description: Max items to return (default 20, max 100). Flat 2 credits per call. Hard ceiling: first 100 matching videos only — deeper history is not available (windowMax=100).

url.description: Twitch channel URL or username, e.g. https://www.twitch.tv/shroud. The URL platform must match this endpoint's platform. Do not pass cross-platform URLs, e.g. YouTube to TikTok, Instagram to Facebook, LinkedIn to X/Twitter, or Pinterest to Rumble.
